docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $482.50 FILED BY LIGHTNING EXPRESS C/O MORRIS PHILLIPS AS TO DEFENDANT GREGORY BRUBAKER, LAW OFFICE OF ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-03-2003 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
